window_scripts.com.apple.Safari:
set fs to character id 31
set rs to character id 30
set gs to character id 29
tell application id "com.apple.Safari"
  set out to ""
  repeat with w in (get windows)
    set b to ""
    try
      set {x1, y1, x2, y2} to bounds of w
      set b to (x1 as text) & gs & (y1 as text) & gs & (x2 as text) & gs & (y2 as text)
    end try
    set n to ""
    try
      set v to name of w
      if v is not missing value then set n to v
    end try
    set u to ""
    set ti to ""
    try
      set tb to current tab of w
      set v to URL of tb
      if v is not missing value then set u to v
      set v to name of tb
      if v is not missing value then set ti to v
    end try
    set out to out & b & fs & n & fs & u & fs & ti & rs
  end repeat
  return out
end tell
